import pyautogui, time

# 1. Click the "Attach" button in Thunderbird
pyautogui.click(891 + 50, 137 + 12)  # center of the Attach button (~941, 149)
time.sleep(1.0)

# 2. Open the location bar in the file chooser
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'l')
time.sleep(0.5)

# 3. Type the full path to the AWS bill
pyautogui.typewrite('/home/mathias/aws-bill.pdf')
time.sleep(0.5)

# 4. Confirm to attach the file
pyautogui.press('enter')
time.sleep(1.0)

import pyautogui, time

# 1. Click the location entry to focus
pyautogui.click(752, 97)
time.sleep(0.5)

# 2. Select all and clear the incorrect path
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'a')
time.sleep(0.2)
pyautogui.press('backspace')
time.sleep(0.2)

# 3. Type the correct tilde‐based path and confirm
pyautogui.typewrite('~/aws-bill.pdf')
time.sleep(0.5)
pyautogui.press('enter')
time.sleep(1.0)
